purpose: Source-to-manuscript coverage of the complete two-web research increment; this is a preservation index, not a count or certification of theorems.

path_conventions.coverage_files: Every path in coverage.files is relative to package_root and occurs exactly once.
path_conventions.project_paths: Preserved downloads, manuscript components, and assembly paths are relative to the project root.
path_conventions.paper_labels: Labels refer to the assembled manuscript. PLAN line ranges are inclusive source selections; 10000 denotes selection through the source end.

baseline.incoming_baseline_identity: SOURCE_MANIFEST.json records the filename, size, original upload identity, and existing checksum of the September 29 manuscript.
baseline.preservation: The previous handoff and all inherited mathematical sources remain separate from the October 1 assembly.

original_download_inputs.role: Complete original incoming archive; its expanded 102-file payload is indexed below.
Separately downloaded integration note, retained independently of the package's own note.

incoming_provenance.checksum_policy: Use the incoming manifest and archive-member map for existing hashes and original paths. This coverage index does not calculate or repeat checksums.
incoming_provenance.scope: The 102-file count includes the two nested ZIP files, not a second count of their members. Each nested member is locatable through ORIGINAL_ARCHIVE_MAP.json. The two outer preserved downloads are recorded separately above.

manuscript.coverage_basis: The integration PLAN and the designated mathematical English components. Placement is distinguished from source preservation, compilation, independent proof review, and publication.

dispositions.imported_full_math: Complete mathematical arguments selected by the recorded PLAN ranges and converted to English LaTeX. This does not mean a byte-for-byte import of status text or of every passage outside those ranges.
dispositions.translated_or_merged_math: Mathematical content translated or integrated by dependency into a manually edited English component; the source and any unselected observations remain intact.
dispositions.overlapping_earlier_proofs: Earlier arguments, independent checks, compatible source copies, or companion presentations. Related results enter the listed manuscript locations, but no whole-file supersession or complete duplication is asserted.
dispositions.working_attempts_retained_intact: Working derivations, candidate routes, or partial analyses preserved as source records without being promoted wholesale to a current theorem.
dispositions.metadata_and_computational_attachments: Provenance, status, source-navigation, literature-positioning, scripts, receipts, numerical outputs, and original containers. Their preservation does not independently validate the mathematical claims.

Original containers preserve all fourteen recorded members, including status files not separately expanded and inherited proofs. Existing same-byte mappings are in the incoming member map.

Original finite-symbol checks, receipts, and triaxial diagnostic attempts. This index neither reruns them nor upgrades a finite check or unsuccessful search to a PDE, compactness, or universal lower-bound proof.

claim_boundaries: The actual finite-density endpoint is incorporated with its Euler-density dependence; density-independent O10 remains open.
The O11 variational, complete ordinary-budget, same-field, and filling results do not determine the unrestricted balanced first-order coefficient.
Compatibility copies, alternate formats, review documents, and parallel proof branches are not counted as separate research breakthroughs.
A later theorem may enlarge an earlier conclusion without absorbing all independent mathematics in that earlier file. Unselected material remains fully preserved at its indexed source path.
The main result catalogue, the manuscript proof status, and the original three-line Yau26 program retain their separate scopes.
